description: This file contains functions for converting Prometheus MetricFamily protobuf messages into the text exposition format, including writing metrics, labels, and handling string escaping.

methods.name: MetricFamilyToText
methods.description: Converts a MetricFamily protobuf message into Prometheus text format and writes it to the provided writer.

methods.name: writeSample
methods.description: Writes a single metric sample line in text format, including labels, value, and optional timestamp.

methods.name: writeNameAndLabelPairs
methods.description: Formats and writes metric name and label pairs, handling legacy validation and escaping.

methods.name: writeEscapedString
methods.description: Escapes special characters in strings for Prometheus exposition format.

methods.name: writeFloat
methods.description: Efficiently writes float64 values to the writer, handling common cases.

methods.name: writeInt
methods.description: Efficiently writes int64 values to the writer.

methods.name: writeName
methods.description: Writes a metric name, quoting if it does not pass legacy validation.
